kamloops.title: BC NDP promises to cap grocery profits while Conservatives unveil wildfire plan
kamloops.description: BC Conservative leader Lorne Doerkson visited a family whose Summerland home was destroyed by the Bald Range wildfire in the summer.

kamloops.title: Kamloops councillor awarded 'precedent-setting' costs, damages in mayor's defamation suit
kamloops.description: A Kamloops city councillor says she's won a "precedent-setting" award for damages, closing out a bitter legal dispute with the city's mayor.

kamloops.title: Former Penticton city councillor found guilty of sexual offences against youth for 2nd time
kamloops.description: An Ontario Superior Court judge has found James Miller, a former Penticton, B.C., city councillor, guilty of historic sexual offences involving youth. Miller was found guilty of sexual assault, sexual interference and invitation to sexual touching.

southeast.title: Human remains found inside sunken vehicle in Kootenay River
southeast.description: Police say they believe the remains are those of George Davis, a man who disappeared from the Creston area in July 2004.

all.title: Canada’s largest fire detector acquires US wildfire business despite barriers
all.description: Wildfire detection company SenseNet, Canada’s largest wildfire detection operator, recently announced the acquisition of N5 Sensors‘ wildfire-related assets, a semiconductor producer in the United States, despite the company’s recent failure in a federal audit and the two nations being in the middle of a trade war.
